dataSources.label: Admin CP Signup Report
dataSources.notes: CSV export from Locumate admin panel.

dataSources.label: Zoho CRM Activities
dataSources.notes: Activity Type, Date, Status, Contact/Lead ID

kpis.title: Win Rate
kpis.formula: COUNT(Stage = 'Closed Won') / COUNT(Stage IN ('Closed Won', 'Closed Lost')) * 100
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 closed deals (won + lost) in the period

kpis.title: Support Issue Volume
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) tickets where Created Time is in the period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 1 ticket in the period
kpis.notes: Richest data source — 4,645 rows with channel, category, resolution, SLA, sentiment.

kpis.title: Prospects (Leads)
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) leads where Created Time is in the period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 1 lead in the period

kpis.title: Pipeline Value
kpis.formula: SUM(Amount) where Stage NOT IN ('Closed Won', 'Closed Lost')
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 1 open deal with Amount > 0

kpis.title: Shifts Completed
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) where Current Shift Status = 'Finished' and Shift Date in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 1 finished shift in the period

kpis.title: Shift Utilisation
kpis.formula: SUM(Hours worked) / SUM(Total Hours Expected) * 100 where Status = Finished and Shift Date in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 finished shifts with hours data in the period

kpis.title: Inactive Pharmacy Rate
kpis.formula: COUNT(pharmacies with 0 finished shifts in period) / COUNT(all distinct pharmacies) * 100
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 5 distinct pharmacies in the dataset

kpis.title: Jobs Posted
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) shifts where Date Created is in the period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 1 shift created in the period

kpis.title: Calls Per Week
kpis.formula: COUNT(Activity Type = 'Call') / weeks in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires Zoho CRM Activities export
kpis.notes: INSUFFICIENT — data source not yet connected.

kpis.title: Signups
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) new signups in period from Admin CP
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires Admin CP Signup Report
kpis.notes: INSUFFICIENT — data source not yet connected.

kpis.title: Churn Leading Indicator
kpis.formula: Composite of declining shift utilisation + rising inactive rate + support sentiment
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires product telemetry for full score
kpis.notes: Partial — 2 of 3 sources connected. Full score needs product telemetry.

kpis.title: Bug Impact
kpis.formula: Weighted count of open bugs by severity
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires bug tracker export
kpis.notes: INSUFFICIENT — data source not yet connected.

kpis.title: Avg Resolution Time
kpis.formula: AVG(Resolution Time in Business Hours) for closed tickets in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 closed tickets with resolution time data

kpis.title: Avg First Response Time
kpis.formula: AVG(First Response Time in Business Hours) for tickets in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 tickets with first response time data

kpis.title: SLA Compliance
kpis.formula: COUNT(SLA Violation Type IS NULL or empty) / COUNT(*) * 100 for tickets in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 tickets in the period

kpis.title: First Call Resolution Rate
kpis.formula: COUNT(Is First Call Resolution = true) / COUNT(*) * 100 for closed tickets
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 closed tickets with FCR data

kpis.title: Ticket Reopen Rate
kpis.formula: COUNT(Number of Reopen > 0) / COUNT(*) * 100 for tickets in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 tickets in the period

kpis.title: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
kpis.formula: AVG(Happiness Rating) for tickets with rating in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 5 tickets with happiness rating data

kpis.title: Sentiment Trend
kpis.formula: Distribution of Sentiment values (positive/neutral/negative) for tickets in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 10 tickets with sentiment data

kpis.title: Average Deal Size
kpis.formula: AVG(Amount) where Stage = 'Closed Won'
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: At least 3 closed-won deals with Amount > 0

kpis.title: Job Seekers
kpis.formula: COUNT(*) locum signups/registrations in period
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires Admin CP locum signup data
kpis.notes: INSUFFICIENT — borderline. Needs Admin CP export.

kpis.title: Adoption by Segment
kpis.formula: Active pharmacies per segment / total pharmacies per segment * 100
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires segment definition + signup data

kpis.title: Onboarding Quality
kpis.formula: Composite score from onboarding completion milestones
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires Admin CP onboarding milestone data

kpis.title: Feature Adoption Trend
kpis.formula: Usage of key features over time from product telemetry
kpis.sufficiencyThreshold: Requires product telemetry integration
